notes: Two English words answer to two morphemes: the *have* goes to the possessive לְ under rule 43 and the *no* to the existential אַיִן under rule 50, which heads on the negation word rather than on any supplied frame.

כֻּלּוֹ divides as rule 19 directs — כֹּל takes *all*, never *all of*, and the suffix takes *of them* headed on the pronoun. MACULA's glosses are reversed across these two segments; the morphology governs, per rule 39.
